segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I have the updated scope in front of me: 42 user seats, three lab locations, and the equipment import for about 1,800 assets. Is that still the right shape for the July rollout?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We may add five seats in September, but for contract start we need 42. The main thing is getting our North Carolina lab live by July 15.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. For July 15, we'd start onboarding June 24, do the asset import that week, and then admin training on July 8 and 9. The services line is a fixed $6,800, and the annual subscription for 42 seats is $31,500.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. On billing, can you split the invoice by location? Finance wants Raleigh at 60 percent, Columbus 25, and Reno 15.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can put those allocations on the order form and the invoice notes. Payment terms are net 30, annual billing. If you want quarterly billing, it adds 4 percent, so the annual prepay is the cleaner option.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Annual is fine. Legal had one question on the renewal term. We don't want an automatic two-year renewal.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. The standard is one-year initial term with one-year renewals, 60-day notice if either side doesn't want to renew. I can set it that way in the contract.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. And support is included, right? We're not buying premium support this year.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. Standard support is included: business hours, email and phone, with the two-hour target for urgent production issues. Premium support is not on this order.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Then I think we're good. Send me the order form today and I'll route it to procurement. PO should be ready by Friday, June 14.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I'll send the order form and implementation dates right after this call. Once the PO is back, we can lock June 24 for kickoff and assign your implementation lead.
